meta.title: Rome, Crete & Athens June 2027
meta.dates: June 7-20+, 2027 (Miami -> Rome -> Crete -> Athens -> Miami, return flight and exact Athens length still TBD)

route.name: Athens
route.sub: a few nights · Grand Hyatt Athens

blocks.title: Dinner at home before leaving
blocks.detail: Eat a real meal at home so nobody is relying on airport food before the overnight flight.

blocks.title: Drive from home to MIA
blocks.detail: ~30-40 min, budgeting extra for end-of-day traffic and drop-off with a family of 4 and bags.

blocks.title: Check in & bag drop - American counter (2 checked bags)
blocks.detail: International check-in for a family of 4 with 2 checked bags. Have passports ready. This puts you at the gate ~1 hr before boarding - tighter than a 3-hr-early arrival, so leave on time and use TSA PreCheck.
blocks.notes: American transatlantic Main Cabin baggage: the 1st checked bag is FREE per passenger. Checking 2 bags across 4 travelers means both are 'first bags' for two different people = $0. (If both bags were put under one passenger, the 2nd would be $200. And even a 3rd/4th bag would still be free as each person's first bag - so there's no reason to pay a bag fee here.) Basic Economy is the exception, but this is a standard Main Cabin partner award, so the free-first-bag allowance applies.

blocks.title: Security screening
blocks.detail: TSA at MIA - allow a generous buffer for an international evening departure with two kids. TSA PreCheck (KTNs are on the reservation) will speed this up if the lanes are open.

blocks.title: Walk to gate, settle in
blocks.detail: Last bathroom stop, get the kids situated before boarding. Dinner already handled at home.

blocks.title: Boarding - AA52
blocks.detail: International boarding typically starts ~45 min before departure.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA52 - Nonstop - 10h5m
blocks.detail: MIA -> FCO, Economy (Main Cabin), 4 passengers. Partner award booked via Alaska Atmos Rewards on American metal (oneworld). Lands Tuesday, June 8 at 12:05 PM local Rome time.
blocks.notes: BOOKED - Alaska confirmation code HBUYUG. 35,000 Atmos Rewards points + $5.60 per passenger x 4 = 140,000 points + $22.40 total (charged to Visa ...6730). Passengers: Roque Corona, Jennifer Borges, Roque Luis Corona, Chloe Corona. Seats 31 A-D assigned. American Airlines confirmation code AKUHCI (use this on aa.com to manage seats/the partner-operated flight); Alaska/Atmos confirmation code HBUYUG. Meal service (complimentary, Main Cabin): dinner served ~9:00-9:30 PM shortly after takeoff, then a lights-out stretch, and a lighter breakfast ~10:00-10:30 AM Rome time (about an hour before the 12:05 PM landing). Kids ate dinner at home at 5 PM, so they may skip the onboard dinner - fine for getting them to sleep. The pre-landing breakfast is the useful one since you arrive at lunchtime.
blocks.flag: Overnight flight - lands 12:05 PM Rome time the next day. Kids will have been awake ~16+ hrs by landing; Day 1 in Rome is kept light on purpose.

blocks.title: Land at FCO - passport, bags, customs
blocks.detail: Passport control, baggage claim, and customs for a family of 4.

blocks.title: Walk to Fiumicino Aeroporto train station
blocks.detail: Signposted inside the terminal, ~5 min from baggage claim.

blocks.title: Leonardo Express - FCO to Roma Termini
blocks.detail: Non-stop, 32 min, Platform 1; departs every 15 min - just catch the next one.
blocks.notes:
• Fare €14/adult x 2 = €28 (station price)
• Kids 4-12 ride free with a paying adult - both covered
• ≈ $30 total; no need to pre-book a departure

blocks.title: Walk to hotel from Roma Termini
blocks.detail: ~550m, ~7-10 min with luggage and kids.

blocks.title: Hyatt Regency Rome Central - check in, drop bags
blocks.detail: Regency Suite; request early check-in, otherwise store bags and head out.
blocks.notes:
• 20,000 pts/night x 3 = 60,000 pts
• Suite Upgrade Award applied → Regency Suite
• Breakfast included daily (up to 4 guests)
blocks.roomType: Regency Suite - separate lounge area, terrace

blocks.title: Late lunch / early dinner - La Famiglia, Esquilino
blocks.detail: Traditional Roman comfort food, ~10 min walk - an easy first meal after the overnight flight.
blocks.notes:
• Mains ~€15 each
• 2 adult mains + 2 kids sharing simple pasta
• Entrees only, no drinks/dessert: ~€55-60 / $62
• Rating ~4.0-4.2 (your lowest-rated Rome pick)

blocks.title: Piazza della Repubblica & Baths of Diocletian
blocks.detail: ~10 min walk; the fountain plus a quick free look inside Santa Maria degli Angeli, built into the ancient baths.

blocks.title: Gelato near Piazza della Repubblica
blocks.detail: The one sweet stop of the day.

blocks.title: Walk back to hotel, settle in
blocks.detail: Early night - the kids will be wiped after the overnight flight.

blocks.title: Taxi to the Colosseum
blocks.detail: ~3 km, ~15 min.
blocks.notes: • Rome taxi: €3 base + ~€1.3/km, €9 min → ~€10-12

blocks.title: Colosseum (interior) - for the kids
blocks.detail: Just the Colosseum - skipping Forum/Palatine (you've done them twice). Book the earliest timed slot.
blocks.notes:
• Tickets ~€18-24/adult; kids under 18 free
• ~€55-60 / $62 for the two of you
• Book ~30 days ahead
• Ticket includes Forum/Palatine (you just won't use it)

blocks.title: Walk to Monti for lunch
blocks.detail: ~15-20 min stroll from the Colosseum.

blocks.title: Lunch - Ai Tre Scalini, Monti
blocks.detail: Classic Roman trattoria/wine bar (~4.4); early lunch to open up the afternoon.
blocks.notes:
• Menu: lasagna €10, eggplant parm €12, carpaccio €14
• 2 adult primi + kids simple pasta, no wine
• Entrees only: ~€40 / $44

blocks.title: Taxi to the Appian Way (Catacombs of San Sebastiano)
blocks.detail: ~5-6 km south, ~25-30 min.
blocks.notes: • Rome taxi: €3 base + ~€1.3/km → ~€16-20

blocks.title: Arrive & join the next guided tour
blocks.detail: 20-min cushion for tickets, bathroom, and the next English tour (run ~every 30 min).

blocks.title: Catacombs of San Sebastiano
blocks.detail: Ancient underground burial tunnels, guided ~45 min; using San Sebastiano since San Callisto closes Wednesdays.
blocks.notes:
• €15/adult, ages 7-16 €12, under 7 free → ~€40-42
• Guided only; open daily 10-5 (last entry 4:30)
blocks.flag: Cool, damp, stairs and uneven passages underground - not stroller-friendly.

blocks.title: Walk the ancient Appian Way to the Gladiator School
blocks.detail: ~1.5 km along the original Roman road; grab a quick taxi (~5 min) if the sun's too much.

blocks.title: Check in & gear up
blocks.detail: 15-min buffer before the 3:00 start - check in, bathroom, tunics on.

blocks.title: Gladiator School - training session
blocks.detail: Gruppo Storico Romano - the 2 kids train (tunic, sword, drills, tournament, certificate) while you two watch.
blocks.notes:
• €130/person ages 6+; both kids = €260 / $285
• Parents watch for free
• Book the 3:00 PM slot; no ID check (readiness matters, best ~8+)
blocks.flag: Hard wooden swords are used - closed shoes and clothes that can get dusty.

blocks.title: Wrap up & meet your ride
blocks.detail: Photos and certificates; arrange the return in advance (next block).

blocks.title: Pre-arranged driver / taxi back to hotel
blocks.detail: ~7 km back to the Termini area, ~25-30 min.
blocks.notes:
• Appian Way isn't taxi-cruising - pre-book a driver for 5:00 PM
• Backups: FreeNow app, or have reception call one (060609)
• Taxi meter ~€22-26

blocks.title: Rest / freshen up at hotel
blocks.detail: Downtime before dinner after a big active day.

blocks.title: Dinner - Trattoria Vecchia Roma, Esquilino
blocks.detail: Historic (1916) Roman trattoria ~10 min away (~4.4), famous for amatriciana flambeed from a cheese wheel.
blocks.notes:
• A la carte mains ~€12-16
• 2 adult mains + kids simple pasta, minimal wine
• Entrees only: ~€50 / $55
• Reserve ahead - long queues

blocks.title: Taxi to the Vatican
blocks.detail: ~5.5 km, ~20-25 min; early to beat the security line.
blocks.notes: • Rome taxi: €3 base + ~€1.3/km → ~€14-18

blocks.title: St. Peter's Square & Basilica
blocks.detail: The square, then the basilica interior (Michelangelo's Pieta, Bernini's baldachin); entry is free - the line is security.
blocks.notes:
• Basilica: FREE, no ticket
• Optional dome climb (on-site only): €8 stairs / €10 lift+stairs, then ~320 steps → ~€30-40 family
• Paid skip-the-line timed reservation available online
blocks.flag: Strict dress code at security, no exceptions: shoulders AND knees covered, kids included.

blocks.title: Taxi across the river to the Pantheon area
blocks.notes: • Rome taxi ~€10-13

blocks.title: Lunch - Cul de Sac, near Piazza Navona
blocks.detail: Historic casual wine bar off Piazza Navona; high chairs, family-friendly - book ahead.
blocks.notes:
• Wine-bar mains ~€18-20
• 2 adult mains + kids simple pasta, one glass of wine
• Entrees only: ~€60 / $66

blocks.title: Piazza Navona
blocks.detail: Baroque fountains and street artists; open space for the kids to move.

blocks.title: Pantheon
blocks.detail: ~5 min walk; the intact ancient dome and oculus. Timed ticket required.
blocks.notes:
• ~€5/adult x 2 = ~€10; kids under 18 free
• Reserve a timed slot online ahead

blocks.title: Walk to the Trevi Fountain
blocks.detail: ~20 min through the old streets.

blocks.title: Trevi Fountain
blocks.detail: Coin toss and people-watching; very crowded - keep the kids close.

blocks.title: Taxi back to hotel
blocks.detail: ~3 km, ~15 min.
blocks.notes: • Rome taxi ~€10-13

blocks.title: Rest at hotel - free time, start packing
blocks.detail: Light afternoon before the early travel day to Crete.

blocks.title: Dinner - Rifugio Romano, Esquilino
blocks.detail: Casual neighborhood trattoria/pizzeria near the hotel (~4.5); easy last night.
blocks.notes:
• Menu: pizza ~€13, amatriciana €13, saltimbocca €15
• 2 adult mains (cheaper pizzas) + kids simple pizza/pasta
• Entrees only: ~€48-50 / $52

blocks.title: Check out of Hyatt Regency Rome Central
blocks.detail: Settle any incidentals and gather the bags.

blocks.title: Walk to Roma Termini
blocks.detail: ~550m, ~7-10 min with luggage.

blocks.title: Leonardo Express - Roma Termini to FCO
blocks.detail: Non-stop, 32 min; departs ~every 15 min.
blocks.notes:
• Fare €14/adult x 2 = €28; kids 4-12 free
• ≈ $30 total

blocks.title: Walk to check-in at FCO
blocks.detail: The train station connects directly to the terminal.

blocks.title: Check in & bag drop (2 checked bags)
blocks.detail: Rome→Crete is intra-EU (Schengen) - no passport control, but allow time with 2 checked bags.

blocks.title: Boarding - FCO → HER
blocks.detail: European boarding starts ~40 min before departure.

blocks.title: Wizz Air Malta / Neos - FCO → HER - Nonstop - ~2h20m
blocks.detail: Rome (Fiumicino) → Heraklion, Economy, 4 passengers. Seasonal summer route; ~11:55 AM departure.
blocks.notes:
• Chosen: ~11:55 AM departure → ~3:30 PM HER (HER is +1 hr vs Rome)
• Midday slot is Wizz Air Malta; Neos also flies midday
• Seasonal route - June operators: Neos + Wizz Air Malta (ITA only from July)
• 2027 fares not loaded - ~$180/pax placeholder → ~$720 family
blocks.flag: Not bookable yet (2027 loads ~Nov 2026-early 2027). Heads-up: in 2026 the 11:55 Wizz flight ran Mon/Wed/Thu/Sat - NOT Fridays - so confirm a Friday 6/11 midday nonstop once the schedule loads (Neos may cover Friday). Fallback: 1-stop via Athens.

blocks.title: Collect bags at the carousel
blocks.detail: ~30-40 min - HER gets busy in summer and you have 2 checked bags.

blocks.title: Budget rental desk (in terminal) - paperwork & booster seats
blocks.detail: Present license, passport, and a credit card in Roque's name for the deposit; add the 2 booster seats here.
blocks.notes:
• Budget, HER - conf 00341393US3 (Priceline 118-226-896-27)
• $456.09 total, due at pickup (nothing prepaid)
• Automatic, unlimited mileage, additional driver, free cancellation
• +2 booster seats charged at the counter (~€90-120 / $100-130 est)
blocks.flag: Reservation lists a 2:00 PM pickup but you land ~3:15 and won't reach the desk until ~4 PM. Budget usually holds the car, but call ahead or modify the reservation to a later pickup so it isn't released as a no-show.

blocks.title: Shuttle bus to the car park
blocks.detail: Budget's desk is in the terminal; a short bus ride reaches the car lot.

blocks.title: Collect & inspect the car, fit booster seats
blocks.detail: Photograph any existing damage, confirm fuel level (full-to-full), install the 2 booster seats.

blocks.title: Drive HER → Elounda
blocks.detail: ~68 km on the A90 coastal motorway (toll-free) via Hersonissos, ~1h-1h10.

blocks.title: Domes of Elounda, Autograph Collection - check in
blocks.detail: Family, 1 Bedroom Suite - 1 King bed + sofa bed, garden view, balcony, outdoor whirlpool. Separate bedroom and living area. Booked and confirmed.
blocks.notes:
• BOOKED - conf 76388550
• 648,000 Marriott Bonvoy pts, 7 nights (Jun 11-18), 2 adults + 2 kids
• Guest: Roque Corona; Room 1 non-commissionable rate
• Free kids club ages 4-12 (both qualify)
blocks.roomType: Family, 1 Bedroom Suite (1 King + sofa bed, garden view, balcony, whirlpool)
blocks.cancelBy: Free cancellation before 11:59 PM local hotel time, May 28, 2027 (14 days before arrival)

blocks.title: Settle in / freshen up
blocks.detail: Light first evening after a full travel day - unpack a little, get the kids sorted.

blocks.title: Dinner - Thólos (resort buffet)
blocks.detail: The resort's main sea-view buffet restaurant (Greek & Mediterranean), with a kids' buffet and rotating themed nights - zero transit on night one.
blocks.notes:
• Half-board buffet venue (breakfast + international buffet dinner); themed nights, kids buffet, veg options
• Your 648k-point rate is likely ROOM-ONLY - dinner would be a paid buffet unless you add Half Board
• Kids-eat-free promo is for DIRECT phone/email bookings, 2026 - unconfirmed for a 2027 points stay; verify with Domes
• No published a la carte buffet price. Proxy: Full-Board supplement €40/adult, €20/child per night
• Inferred family buffet dinner ~€90-130 / ~$120 (estimate) - could drop a lot if under-12s eat free

blocks.title: Drive to Plaka village boat dock
blocks.detail: ~5km from Elounda.

blocks.title: Boat to Spinalonga
blocks.detail: First boat of the day, deliberately - the island gets crowded and hot by late morning.
blocks.notes: ~€10-12/person round-trip x4 -> ~€44-48/$48.

blocks.title: Spinalonga Island
blocks.detail: The Venetian fortress and former leper colony - walkable ruins and streets, not an indoor museum.
blocks.notes: €20/adult entrance, kids likely free/reduced (verify at booking) -> budgeting ~€90-100/$100 for the family total (boat + entry).

blocks.title: Lunch - Taverna Spinalonga, Plaka village
blocks.detail: Seaside, fresh fish, right by the boat dock.

blocks.title: Dinner - Vilebrequin La Plage (resort)
blocks.detail: Seaside Mediterranean/seafood, on-site.

blocks.title: Resort beach & pool - free morning
blocks.detail: No anchor today - kids club available (free, ages 4-12) if the kids want a program morning.

blocks.title: Lunch - Antonino's (resort)
blocks.detail: On-site Italian, wood-fired pizza/pasta.

blocks.title: Dinner - Ostria, Elounda
blocks.detail: Seafood, 1.4km from the resort.

blocks.title: Agios Nikolaos - Lake Voulismeni & harbor
blocks.detail: Small saltwater lake connected to the harbor by a canal, lively waterfront promenade.

blocks.title: Lunch - Karnagio (Pita tou Riga)
blocks.detail: Right on Lake Voulismeni, grill-focused - arrive early, it's busy.

blocks.title: Dinner - Kanali, Elounda
blocks.detail: Seafood, 3.5km from the resort.

blocks.title: Boat trip & snorkeling, Mirabello Bay
blocks.detail: Elounda Boat Rentals & Watersports - family-run since 1984, no-license boat rentals, kayaking/SUP/snorkeling in the bay's sea caves.
blocks.notes: Half-day no-license boat rental estimate ~€150-180/$160-190 for the family - get a live quote closer to booking.

blocks.title: Dinner - Blue Door (Mple Porta), Agios Nikolaos
blocks.detail: Waterfront seafood, grilled octopus.

blocks.title: Drive to Milatos Cave
blocks.detail: ~45 min.

blocks.title: Walk to the cave entrance
blocks.detail: ~10-15 min walk, closed shoes needed.

blocks.title: Milatos Cave
blocks.detail: Free entry, family-friendly, low ceilings inside (bring a phone flashlight) - real historical site, not a museum.

blocks.title: Drive to the Lassithi Plateau
blocks.detail: ~45min-1hr from the Milatos/Agios Nikolaos area.

blocks.title: Lassithi Plateau - windmills & village
blocks.detail: Famous (mostly decommissioned) stone windmills across the high plateau.

blocks.title: Dinner - Makris Fine Dining (resort)
blocks.detail: Michelin-affiliated chef Petros Dimas - the special night of the Crete stay.
blocks.notes: Fine-dining pricing - reserve ahead.

days.title: Beach day / resort - last day in Crete

blocks.title: Lunch - Taverna Maria's, Plaka village
blocks.detail: Traditional Cretan dishes, one more trip to the pretty little harbor before leaving.

blocks.title: Dinner - Taverna Giorgos-Giovanni, Plaka village
blocks.detail: On the rocks overlooking Spinalonga - a fitting send-off view for the last Crete night.

blocks.title: Check out of Domes of Elounda, load the car
Drive Elounda -> Heraklion Airport
blocks.detail: ~65 km, allow a full hour plus a little cushion for morning traffic near Heraklion.

blocks.title: Return rental car - Budget, HER
blocks.detail: Drop-off booked for 9:00 AM. Fuel up near the airport first (full-to-full). Keep the contract/photos of the car.

blocks.title: Coffee & wait at the airport
blocks.detail: The 9:00 AM car drop leaves a generous cushion before the 12:15 PM flight - deliberate, so a slow Elounda-HER drive or the car return never puts the flight at risk. Relax, coffee, let the kids move around.

blocks.title: Check in & bag drop - domestic (2 checked bags)
blocks.detail: Domestic Greek flight - lighter process than the international check-in, but still allow time with 2 checked bags.

blocks.title: Aegean Airlines - HER -> ATH - Nonstop - ~50m
blocks.detail: Heraklion -> Athens, Economy, 4 passengers. Short domestic hop.
blocks.notes: Departs ~12:15 PM, arrives Athens ~1:05 PM. $253 total for the family (cash fare, per your search). Aegean and Sky Express both fly this route frequently; 2027 schedules aren't loaded yet, so this is a representative flight at your quoted time and price.
blocks.flag: Not yet bookable - 2027 schedule not published. Times and price are yours from a current search.

blocks.title: Taxi to Grand Hyatt Athens
blocks.detail: ~35-44 km, ~35-45 min. Athens airport has a fixed taxi rate to the city center (~€40 day / €55 night); a pre-booked private van is a comfortable alternative with luggage and 2 kids.
blocks.notes: Fixed airport taxi ~€40-55, or a pre-booked private transfer at a similar rate.

blocks.title: Grand Hyatt Athens - check in, drop bags
blocks.detail: 115 Syngrou Avenue. Grand Suite via Suite Night Award; if the room isn't ready, leave bags and head out.
blocks.points: 20000/night (+ Suite Night Award for Grand Suite)
blocks.roomType: Grand Suite (via Suite Night Award upgrade)
blocks.notes: 20,000 points/night + a Suite Night Award to upgrade all 4 of you to the Grand Suite. Breakfast included daily. Rooftop pool with Acropolis views. Number of Athens nights still TBD - adjust once the return flight is set.
blocks.cancelBy: Not yet booked - pending total nights decision

blocks.title: Rest / freshen up at the hotel
blocks.detail: Easy landing after the travel morning and in the June afternoon heat - regroup before an evening out.

blocks.title: Explore Plaka, Anafiotika & Monastiraki
blocks.detail: Athens's old town below the Acropolis - pedestrian lanes, the tiny whitewashed Anafiotika quarter that feels like a Cycladic island village, and the lively Monastiraki area. An easy, low-key first evening on foot.

blocks.title: Dinner - Tzitzikas kai Mermigas or a Plaka taverna
blocks.detail: Casual, popular Greek mezze spot - fresh chips the kids will love and traditional plates for the adults. Plenty of relaxed family tavernas nearby if you'd rather just wander into one.
blocks.notes: Mezze/taverna pricing: 2 adult mains + shared plates, kids on simple items (chips, chicken, souvlaki) or sharing, minimal wine. ~€75-85/$80-90.

blocks.title: Acropolis & Parthenon - 8 AM timed entry
blocks.detail: The one essential Athens site. Book the 8:00 AM slot in advance - in June the marble becomes a heat sink and gets brutally hot and crowded by late morning, so early is the whole game. It's an open-air archaeological site, not a museum. Allow ~90 min-2 hrs on the rock.
blocks.notes: ~€30/adult in peak season; kids under 18 free (under-6 always free). Budget ~€60/$65 for 2 adults. Book the 8 AM timed slot ~1 week ahead - morning slots sell out first in June.
blocks.flag: Hats, water, and real shoes - the marble is slippery and there's almost no shade up top.

blocks.title: Walk down into Plaka
blocks.detail: Descend the pedestrian paths from the Acropolis straight into the old town.

blocks.title: Explore Plaka & Anafiotika by daylight
blocks.detail: Wander the lanes, small shops, the island-like Anafiotika streets - shady and easy after the climb.

blocks.title: Lunch - To Kafeneio, Plaka
blocks.detail: Authentic, relaxed Greek taverna at the foot of the Acropolis - familiar plates for the kids, classic Greek cooking for the adults.
blocks.notes: Taverna pricing: 2 adult mains + kids on simple dishes/sharing, minimal wine. ~€75-85/$80-90.

blocks.title: Midday heat break - Grand Hyatt rooftop pool
blocks.detail: Deliberate downtime through the hottest part of a June afternoon. The rooftop pool has Acropolis views - the kids get pool time, everyone resets before the evening.

blocks.title: Panathenaic Stadium (Kallimarmaro)
blocks.detail: The all-marble stadium that hosted the first modern Olympics in 1896. Kids get full access to the track and can run a lap, climb the stands, and walk the athletes' tunnel - active and fun, not a static museum stop. Late-afternoon timing avoids the worst heat on the marble.
blocks.notes: €10/adult, kids reduced/under-6 free -> ~€22-25 for the family. Open till 7 PM (last entry 6:30). Tickets sold on site only. Includes an audio guide.
blocks.flag: Marble stands get hot and the steps are steep - good shoes, watch the kids on the stairs.

blocks.title: Stroll the National Garden & Zappeion
blocks.detail: Shady public garden right by the stadium - ponds, big trees, a easy green wind-down at golden hour. Walkable from the stadium.

blocks.title: Dinner - Kuzina (Acropolis view), Thissio
blocks.detail: Modern Greek on Adrianou Street under the Temple of Hephaestus, with an Acropolis view from the rooftop - a memorable Athens dinner that's still relaxed. Book well ahead; it fills up. ~7 PM catches the sunset light.
blocks.notes: Nicer sit-down with a view - a small step up from the tavernas. 2 adult mains + kids on simpler plates, one glass of wine. ~€120-135/$130-145. Reserve in advance.

blocks.title: Taxi to Lake Vouliagmeni
blocks.detail: ~24 km south down the coast, ~25-30 min from Syngrou Avenue.

blocks.title: Lake Vouliagmeni - swim in the thermal lake
blocks.detail: A natural brackish lake fed by underground thermal springs and the sea, ringed by cliffs - warm (~24-29C), calm, and unusually kid-friendly, with sunbeds, showers, and a cafe. The little Garra rufa fish give a natural 'fish spa' nibble that kids find hilarious. A real nature spot, not a built attraction - a great change of pace from the ancient sites.
blocks.notes: Entry ~€19/adult (weekend), ~€17/child 6-12, under-6 free -> ~€65-70 for the family + sunbeds. Arrive by opening to beat the Sunday crowd.
blocks.flag: Sunscreen/lotion is NOT allowed in the lake - use a rash guard/UV shirt and hats instead, or apply after swimming.

blocks.title: Lunch by the water
blocks.detail: The lake's own restaurant has a kids' menu, or head 5 min to a seaside taverna in Vouliagmeni.
blocks.notes: Seaside pricing a touch higher: 2 adult mains + kids simple plates, minimal wine. ~€85-90/$90-95.

blocks.title: Afternoon rest / rooftop pool
blocks.detail: Relaxed last-built afternoon - pool and downtime. (Return flight home still open, so this is the current end of the planned days.)

blocks.title: Lycabettus Hill at sunset
blocks.detail: Athens's highest point - a short funicular ride up to a 360 view over the whole city, the Acropolis, and out to the sea. Best at golden hour. Easy for the kids (you ride up, not hike).
blocks.notes: Funicular ~€10 round trip/adult, reduced for kids -> ~€30 for the family.

blocks.title: Dinner - Kolonaki neighborhood
blocks.detail: Come down into stylish, walkable Kolonaki at the foot of Lycabettus for a final Athens dinner - lots of relaxed tavernas and casual spots around the square.
blocks.notes: 2 adult mains + kids simple plates, one glass of wine. ~€90-95/$95-105.

items.note: Explicitly left out per your request - still searching.

items.note: All bookable closer to the date.

items.note: Guided-only, book ahead in summer. San Callisto is closed Wednesdays, so we're using San Sebastiano (open daily 10-5).

items.note: The "Kids Stay, Eat & Play Free" (under-12) offer is published for DIRECT phone/email bookings and marked valid 2026 - our booking is a Marriott points award for 2027, so it likely does NOT auto-apply. Email reservations (info@domesofelounda.com / +30 231 0810624) to confirm whether under-12s eat free, at which restaurants (buffet vs a la carte), and your board basis.
